title: Kami
_note: Saltreach, the errand boy who wants to be a Sword-singer. Lines keep MAIN_QUEST.md IDs where they have one, for voicing. Options show short text; spoken is the fuller line he says. starts: the first whose condition holds opens the conversation.

idle.speaker: Kami
idle.text: Are you a fighter? You look like a fighter. I'm going to be a Sword-singer. I've been practising with a stick. I've only hit myself twice today.

crabs.speaker: Kami
crabs.text: Mudcrabs. On the south beach, past the dunes. If I bring back claws, the fishermen's boys have to call me Sword-singer for a whole month. I went once. [Quietly.] They're really big.

paid.speaker: Kami
paid.text: You did it! All of them? Can I have the claws? [He holds out every coin he has.] It's twenty-five. It's everything. It's worth it.

choices.text: [Give him the claws and the coins back.]
